_note: Product demo of the website (desktop recording, full frame, subtitles burned in), 60 s max. Chapters from tools/record-demo.mjs (DEMO_DESKTOP=1), narrated by Brian.
name: web

items.title: A friend’s tip is enough
items.label: 1 · Find a place and book
items.text: WeKaribu: guests write in their language, the host hears it in hers. Vivian types what a friend told her, and the search locks on Noor's farm. She books a day Noor published, and pays the deposit by M-Pesa, straight to Noor's phone.

items.title: Noor decides
items.label: 2 · The host decides; feedback is read on the phone
items.text: Noor accepts: the final call is hers, by app or by SMS. After the visit, a guestbook page in German is read and translated on the phone, offline; voice notes work the same way.

items.title: The week, in Swahili
items.label: 3 · The week, in Swahili
items.text: Ten fixed topics, good or bad; anything unsure is flagged for a person. The summary is human-written Swahili the AI only fills in, and Noor can listen to it.

items.title: A thank-you, with consent
items.label: 4 · A thank-you, with consent
items.text: A thank-you in the guest's language, sent only with consent, and only when Noor taps send. No server, no account, and it works offline. WeKaribu: we welcome.
